$comment: Every portal handoff page, measured by check.mjs against .claude/rules/figma-handoff-page-structure.md. Register a page the day it is created, conformant or not. rootDepth is 1 for a single-portal page, 0 when the page wraps several portals in #EAEAEA product sections. A portal may span several pages of its own file: register each page as '<Portal> · <Page>'; --portal <Portal> checks them all.
